summary: Tyra Biosciences filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose initial Phase 2 SURF302 results for oral dabogratinib in FGFR3-altered low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. As of the August 31, 2026 cutoff, the 60 mg once-daily cohort showed 79% ORR and 64% complete response by best overall response, with favorable tolerability and no Grade 4/5 events. The company selected 60 mg QD to support its planned registrational adjuvant strategy. No transaction, shareholder, or structural event is present; this is a clinical data update, not a special situation.
